title: WeddingDocument
description: A file attached to a wedding or one of its vendors (issue #48): its metadata. The bytes are a separate record (collection document_content) under the same key, groupedKey(wedding_id, document_id).

document_id.description: Identity within the owning tenant's partition, from the injected id generator.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

vendor_id.description: The wedding's vendor (issue #33) the file belongs to, when it belongs to one.

filename.description: The uploaded file's name, without any path (the planner's reference; downloads are named from the title).

content_type.description: Decided from the file's content (its signature), never from what the client declared.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the bytes, checked again on download.

shared_with_couple.description: Whether the couple sees and downloads it.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC upload time, from the injected clock.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last change, when changed.
